title: Hold an introduction agent licence
what: Carry on business as an introduction agent (introducing people for dating or companionship) only while holding a licence.

sources.title: Introduction Agents Act 2001 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on the business of an introduction agent unless the person holds a licence
